title: Smoothness is equivalent to lifting along small extensions of Artinian local rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: Over a locally Noetherian base and for a locally finitely presented morphism, the lemma characterises smoothness by a lifting property against a restricted class of test rings: solid diagrams over small extensions of Artinian local rings with a finite type map. The proof must show that lifting against this restricted class already forces smoothness, which requires relating the Artinian test rings to the infinitesimal lifting criterion and controlling the finite type condition on the map to the base. The restriction of the test class while keeping the conclusion is what makes the argument substantive. Retained author proof at lines 3623-3641 statement, proof 3643-3670.
